result.summary: Found one significant visual issue: a restaurant card displays a missing-image placeholder instead of its photo.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card under “Popular right now” shows a large gray panel with a broken-image icon instead of a restaurant or food photo.
issues.suggestion: Restore the card’s image by checking its source and loading behavior, and use an intentional fallback image if the photo is unavailable.
